cc:Work.dc:title: Historical Replogle K562 diagnostics (all-cell SAE training)
cc:Work.dc:description: Historical reported aggregates from docs/COMPONENT2_RESULTS.md (2026-07-18, including the later correction). Original per-perturbation JSONs are not archived. Panel A: descriptive v3 seed-0 sensitivity. Panel B: corrected v4 tested-pool split, 6/51 core-essential-tag vs 14/111 other tested TFs; 95% Wilson intervals are binomial approximations. No enrichment, equivalence or sweep-significance claim. Panels use different metric versions.

g.text: B: "Other tested TFs" means outside the core-essential tag, not the NEGv1 reference set.

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #4b5563

g.text: Wilson intervals assume binomial sampling; they omit seed/run and biological-replicate uncertainty. No enrichment or equivalence claim.
